99:t_1:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「How are things on Earth?」

99:t_1:5.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Judging from the observation data too, we can be sure that the world of the red sea... the world where $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ and the Angels existed... has vanished because of the transfer.」

99:t_1:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$ＮＥＲＶ$$... the EVAs... the Angels... So it all disappears, and we never understood any of it...」

99:t_1:7.en:
$$レイアム$$
「But if the phenomenon centered on EVA Unit-01 had kept going like that...」

99:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「At worst, everything in the world might have been destroyed... That thing had something about it that made me think so.」

99:t_1:9.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I hear that world had suffered two world-scale disasters like that in the past.」

99:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then that was the third one... In other words, a $$サードインパクト$$...?」

99:t_1:11.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I've heard that $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ was fighting the Angels to prevent it.」

99:t_1:12.en:
$$オットー$$
「Anyway, thanks to the $$時空震動$$, the world was spared destruction.」

99:t_1:13.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Could it have been caused by the spear-shaped object that came flying in back then...?」

99:t_1:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「We can't know now. ...If a $$時空震動$$ had to happen anyway, I wish it had warped the $$新地球皇国$$ away.」

99:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「I know. I have no intention of relying on accidents or flukes like a $$時空震動$$.」

99:t_1:17.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll break through this situation with our own strength.」

99:t_1:19.en:
$$オットー$$
「First, we're going down to Japan. Now that the Empire has broken through 《$$新日本$$》, that area will become a battlefield from here on.」

99:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Is this about $$シンジ$$ and the others?」

99:t_1:28.en:
$n
「If we'd had more power, would we have been able to save $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#pt394$$...?」

99:t_1:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Who knows... I get the feeling that thing was already beyond human understanding.」

99:t_1:30.en:
$n
「...Was there nothing we could do but stand by and watch...?」

99:t_1:31.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There was nothing else we could do at that point.」

99:t_1:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't blame yourself, $n. It's nobody's fault.」

99:t_1:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And of course it isn't $$シンジ$$'s fault either, even though he was at the center of that phenomenon.」

99:t_1:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Switch gears. We don't know when a battle will break out.」

99:t_1:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No... if anyone comes, it'll be $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

99:t_1:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「As you know, the $$新地球皇国$$ rules only the Earth, and has left the colonies alone.」

99:t_1:41.en:
$$エマ$$
「Is that because their objective is to lay $$レイライン$$ and draw $$次元力$$ out of the Earth?」

99:t_1:43.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What matters isn't the reason but what's happening now. Trying to escape the Empire's rule, some of Earth's residents are attempting to emigrate to the colonies.」

99:t_1:44.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is $$ネオ・ジオン$$ taking them in?」

99:t_1:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...If that were all, there'd be no problem.」

99:t_1:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「While the $$地球連邦$$ wore itself down fighting the Empire, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ reinforced its personnel. Because of that, the situation will start moving again.」

99:t_1:47.en:
$$カツ$$
「Don't tell me those guys... are planning to attack Earth at this chance...!」

99:t_1:48.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「That can't be...! Most of Earth is already ruled by the invaders...!」

99:t_1:49.en:
$$アムロ$$
「At this point, we don't know much about the actual state of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. $$ブライト$$ is moving $$ロンド・ベル$$ too, but very little information is coming in.」

99:t_1:50.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I hear Colonel $$シャア$$ went back to the colonies to confirm the situation. Isn't anything coming in from there?」

99:t_1:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You needn't worry about that, $$ハサウェイ$$. He will never go back to being the $$赤い彗星$$ of $$ジオン$$.」

99:t_1:55.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If you two say so, I can rest easy.」

99:t_1:56.en:
$$ファ$$
「The current head of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is $$ハマーン・カーン$$, right?」

99:t_1:58.en:
$$カツ$$
「That woman was hostile to the $$地球連邦$$. She may intend to crush the worn-out Federation completely.」

99:t_1:59.en:
$$エマ$$
「But if they descend to Earth, they'll clash with the Empire.」

99:t_1:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$ is no fool. I can't imagine she'd take on both the Empire and the Federation in this situation.」

99:t_1:61.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You think quite highly of $$ハマーン・カーン$$, don't you?」

99:t_1:62.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Maybe I just want to believe it.」

99:t_1:63.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and Earth aren't likely to fight side by side either. There have even been reports of $$連邦軍$$ units sent to investigate the colonies being attacked by $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

99:t_1:64.en:
$$カツ$$
「What on earth does $$ジオン$$ want to do...!?」

99:t_1:67.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Can you sense that man's presence?」

99:t_1:69.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But this inexplicable situation seems similar to the air that surrounds him.」

99:t_1:70.en:
$n
「Are you saying $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is moving on $$フル・フロンタル$$'s will?」

99:t_1:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
「True, his logic was unique, but...」

99:t_1:72.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$ is the only one who has met and spoken with that man in person. There may well be something that only $$バナージ$$ can sense.」

99:t_1:73.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I also think we need to be wary of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. The region of space we're in now is within their sphere of influence too.」

99:t_1:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If we keep going like this, it'll become clear. What $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will do.」

99:t_1:77.en:
$$カツ$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$...!? Or is it $$ネオ・ジオン$$...!?」

99:t_1:81.en:
$$アムロ$$
(As I thought, $$バナージ$$ is sensing him...)

99:t_1:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
(If so, what is he aiming for in this situation, $$フル・フロンタル$$...)

99:t_2:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You seem displeased that I took the front line, Captain $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$.」

99:t_1:47: Katz 'あいつ等' = Neo Zeon implied, rendered 'those guys' (Amuro's previous line settles it)

99:t_1:64: Katz's bare ジオン rendered with token $$ジオン$$ (Zeon) although Neo Zeon is meant

99:t_1:5: 転移 = 'transfer' (matches earlier slices); 赤い海の世界 = 'world of the red sea'
